symptom: `create or modify navigation Responsive { menu item … }` (a statement that states only a menu) passes check and exec, then the profile has no home page and mx check reports CE0527 "Select a default home page for this profile"; the role home pages, login page and not-found page are gone too
cause: navPatchWebProfile wrote HomePage, HomeItems, LoginPageSettings and NotFoundHomepage unconditionally from the spec — an empty spec field cleared the stored one — while Menu, OfflineEntityConfigs, ThrowPartialSyncError and ProgressiveWebAppSettings were already guarded (HasMenu/HasSync/pointer). navPatchNativeProfile rebuilt RoleBasedNativeHomePages the same way
insight: Half of one writer was guard-don't-drop and half was not, and the docs said both ('fully replaces' and 'omitting the block leaves it alone'). describe -> exec could never show it because describe states every clause; only a hand-written partial statement does. Role homes are merged per role (stated role replaces, unmentioned role kept), so MDL can no longer REMOVE a role home page — there is no clearing syntax for home/login/not-found. Patchers now copy the bson.D first: navSetField writes in place, and a test that reused its input doc only passed because an appended field used to force a reallocation
